subject: Region lock confirmation & ops window for canary migration
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finsecure.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@finsecure.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: FinSecure region pin & isolation — evidence and ops window request

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this through with us. As part of our Dedicated deployment acceptance we need confirmation of the following before we sign off:

- Full region pin: that our tenant will be hosted in the us-west-2 region and will not be replicated out-of-region except for the documented backup snapshot policy.
- Isolation model: whether a tenant-level network/host fence will be used (tenant-scoped VPC + dedicated GPU pool) or a logical multi-tenant slice with host-separation controls.
- Deletion/retention proof: example artifacts showing a completed tenant purge (audit log extract, snapshot checksums, purge job id).
- Ops window for a canary switchover and deletion simulation — we prefer a weekday overnight window (PST) the week of Nov 22.

Can you confirm which artifacts you can provide and propose specific windows for the canary? Also let us know if you need any paperwork (PO/contract) completed prior to the work.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Cloud Compliance, FinSecure
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finsecure.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinSecure region pin & isolation — evidence and ops window request

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. High level answers and what we can provide:

- Region pin: Confirmed — your tenant will be pinned to us-west-2. We will not replicate primary serving traffic or active KV caches outside that region; managed backups may be stored in an encrypted snapshot archive with explicit retention rules (we list those in the runbook).

- Isolation model: We will use tenant-scoped GPU pools (logical tenancy with vNIC isolation and host affinity). The runbook attached has the host-affinity policy, node labelling, and the network egress controls we apply.

- Deletion/retention proof: We can provide an anonymized purge-job log extract, snapshot manifest with checksums, and the audit entries that show the retention policy flip and purge completion. See snapshot_manifest.csv attached as sample; full purge_job log will be produced in the canary.

- Ops window: Our ops team proposes two candidate windows: Tue Nov 23 02:00–04:00 PST or Thu Nov 25 01:00–03:00 PST. We can perform a canary delete and produce the evidence artifacts within the same 24-hour turn. If you prefer a different time, say which you want and we will accommodate.

Next steps:
1) Confirm preferred window.
2) Provide a short list of data subsets (sample tenant IDs) for the canary; we will operate on non-prod/representative copies.
3) Signing: we do not need a new PO to run the canary, but if you want the explicit play executed under a statement of work we can escalate.

Attaching: runbook_v2.pdf (ops steps + evidence checklist), and a small sample snapshot_manifest.csv.

-Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finsecure.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Compliance Team <compliance@finsecure.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2026 09:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinSecure region pin & isolation — evidence and ops window request

Evelyn — that all looks good. We will take Thu Nov 25 01:00–03:00 PST for the canary. A few clarifications:

- For the purge artifact we require at minimum: job id, start/finish timestamps, per-object checksums, and the storage zone IDs where snapshots were resident. Please redact any full tenant content — checksums and job metadata are sufficient.
- SOC2/ISO: can you also include the short attestation snippet from your SOC2 report that references data segregation controls (page/section reference or exported excerpt)?
- Please include the names of the engineers who will be executing the canary and their on-call number for the window.

We will share the sample tenant IDs by EOD Friday. Also please put the runbook and artifacts into a shared drive link for compliance review.

Thanks,
Alex
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finsecure.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FinSecure region pin & isolation — evidence and ops window request

Alex — hi, David from Infra Ops. Confirming technical details and what we'll produce during the canary on Nov 25 01:00–03:00 PST: 

- Host/Region: Tenant will be scheduled on node pool tagged finsecure-usw2; primary network egress blocked to other regions via egress ACLs. Storage snapshots for this canary will remain in us-west-2 S3 buckets (replication disabled for the test).

- Canary steps (high level):
  1) Quarantine traffic to the canary tenant and snapshot a pre-delete image (hashes recorded).
  2) Run purge job (internal id: PURGE-4729) — this will execute tenant object deletion, KV sweep, and ephemeral cache purge.
  3) Trigger post-delete snapshot and record checksums.
  4) Produce audit bundle: purge_job_4729.log (job trace), snapshot_checksums.txt, and an audit CSV with storage zone ids.

- Evidence format: we will provide a CSV manifest (filename, object-id, checksum), a purge job log (trimmed to metadata lines), and an ops-run checklist signed off by two engineers. We will not include object-level data payloads — only metadata and cryptographic hashes.

- SOC2 snippet: ops will include the standard segregation excerpt (exported as a PDF snippet) and the control ID reference. If you need the full report, coordinate with your vendor compliance team — we will provide an excerpt for the review.

Engineers on the run: Priya Natarajan (on-call: +1-650-555-0102) and David Kim (on-call: +1-650-555-0120).

I have dropped a minimal sample of the purge job output and a checksum list into the shared drive link referenced by Evelyn. If anything else is required before the canary we can run a prep dry-run on Nov 23.

-David
David Kim
Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Redwood Inference
